operations: Read exact twelve original small JSON files on Windows
Compute SHA-256 of those twelve raw files
Verify slot canonical digest, attempt bindings and available report digests

not_performed: No telemetry, rosbag, log or frame payload read
No WSL command, native reader, build, test or simulation
No production code, main branch, frozen flight source or source result mutation
No independent started-marker or plan-file read
